scope: Authored local process/transport contracts; no genuine ngrok, provider, model or installed-lifecycle acceptance.

cases.NG01: Only the explicit private credential source is read; either alias and identical aliases work without modifying it or choosing an ambient account.
cases.NG02: Missing, empty, duplicated, malformed or conflicting configured credentials refuse.
cases.NG03: Actual authored child environment and argv contain only the selected token environment field; structured observation binds one URL, upstream, executable and process. No secret persists in run files.
cases.NG04: Wrong upstream, foreign endpoint name and malformed/non-HTTPS origins refuse for the precise expected reason.
cases.NG05: Duplicate endpoints, later uncertain events and agent errors refuse. Only recognized error identifiers, fixed categories, stage and exit status survive diagnostics.
cases.NG06: Executable, generated configuration, credential source, home, argv and upstream changes invalidate observation.
cases.NG07: Unknown process liveness refuses before endpoint authority.
cases.NG08: The finite deadline independently stops and reaps the actual owned group.
cases.NG09: Executable symlink, pin mismatch and occupied run directory refuse before process creation.
cases.NG10: Existing authoritative receiver checks also govern the ngrok observation; transport evidence issues no webhook reference.
cases.NG11: The complete transport-only runner preserves exact source binding, three probes, zero provider authority and owned cleanup; wrong upstream fails.
cases.NG12: Unknown cleanup remains unknown; malformed, oversized or closed stdout and unsafe/replaced credential files refuse. Recovery in the authored fault fixture stops only its original child.

live_packet.precondition: Lead review of exact source, executable pin, private packet and command before token access or launch. A new rejection stops dependent execution.

history: The previous public-endpoint invocation was interrupted by an automated content check. Its precise cause remains unknown; this source implementation does not resolve or erase that history.
